name: ═══════════════ 421 IRRIGATION STATUS (mobile UI) ═══════════════
info:
## Irrigation status dashboard

**Flow:** 421-irrigation-status-dashboard.json

### MQTT
- `stat/IrigationSystem/#` — zones + 24V
- `stat/pompaApa/POWER1` — pump relay (timers)
- `tele/pompaApa/STATE` — Tasmota JSON → **pump web link** (`http://<IP>/`)
- 1s inject — refresh **running** elapsed times

### Timers
Flow context stores start/end/duration per zone and pump (OFF→ON / ON→OFF edges).
Each zone card shows **Started**, **Ended**, **Duration** (running elapsed while ON; last completed run while OFF).

### Event log
Up to **25** recent state changes (newest first): pump, zones, 24V — timestamp + icon + text.

### Areas
**A:** I1–I10. **B:** I11 & I12.

### SMS alerts
Set **`flow.irrigation_sms_to`** (or use the **SMS Gateway** dashboard phone — **`flow.sms_phone`** from flow 510) to a **digits-only** number (min **8** digits). Publishes on **`mqtt_broker_local`** topic **`sms/gateway/command/send`** (same as flow 510 — not the device MQTT broker).

### Telegram alerts
Same events as SMS. Uses **`flow.telegram_chat_ids`** (from flow 50 when you message the bot). **After a Node-RED restart** that list is empty until you send any message to the bot again — the flow also **falls back** to chat `991635368` (same allowlist as flow 50) so alerts still work. Messages are plain text (no Markdown) to avoid API rejections.

### Weather (Open-Meteo)
- Fetches **4×/day** (every **6 h**).
- Set **`flow.irrigation_lat`** / **`flow.irrigation_lon`** and optional **`flow.irrigation_location_name`** (defaults: **Lunca Cetățuii**, Iași — ~47.10°N, 27.56°E).
- **Rain skip**: `flow.irrigation_rain_skip_mm` (default 1), `flow.irrigation_rain_skip_prob` (default 70).

### Scheduler
- **Lawn** default **03:00**, **Flowers** default **05:00** local (Node-RED host time).
- `flow.irrigation_sched_area_a_hour` / `_minute`, same for B.
- `flow.irrigation_scheduler_enabled` = `false` to disable.
- **Lawn** → **Gate lawn** (`run-gate`, Lawn program); **Flowers** → **Gate Flowers** (`run-gate`, Flowers program).
- Scheduler uses **link** nodes like the **Start** buttons. Weather: **UI init** + deploy inject + every **6 h**.
- **Trigger Irrigation Lawn / Flowers** buttons on the “next run” cards send the same `ON` message via **`Test → Gate … (420)`** link nodes (no rain check — manual trigger only).
